name: default deny applies to an unknown call
path and context deny match together
policy:
version: 1
agents:
  writer:
    tools:
      write_file:
        rules:
          - action: deny
            target:
              context:
                phase: prompt
            condition:
              path_pattern: /etc/*

name: global deny overrides a specific allow
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
agents:
  bot:
    tools:
      curl:
        rules:
          - action: allow

name: invalid regex is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: "["
